title: chore: bump objectui pin to include chart list-view fix
body:
Bumps `.objectui-sha` to pick up objectstack-ai/objectui#1434, which fixes a `type: 'chart'` list view rendering an empty plot (app-shell's ObjectView now hands ObjectChart a structured `aggregate`/`xAxisKey`/`series` instead of the flat spec keys it ignored).

Surfaced by the `example-showcase` Task view gallery ("Hours by Status (Chart)"), which now renders a correct bar chart.
